title: Suspended Chief Demands Entry to Poland's Court as Judges Plan a Disciplinary Draw
dek: A judge elected by Tusk's majority runs the tribunal under police guard. Its PiS-era president, shut out on Monday, calls her a usurper; Nawrocki calls it a forcible takeover.
body: A judges' assembly meets on 3 November to adopt the budget and draw lots for disciplinary panels.

panels.label: Nawrocki and PiS Say
panels.text: Nawrocki calls it a “forcible takeover of a constitutional organ of the state”; the suspended president calls the acting head a usurper.

panels.label: Tusk and the Minister Say
panels.text: Tusk says restoring the rule of law “requires decisive action”; the justice minister says the court should hear cases again within weeks.

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: One side speaks of a coup, the other of the rule of law; beneath both is who holds the court that can strike down Poland's laws.
